text: Bad news. Every screw, bolt and rivet just vanished. For five seconds.
Your car's wheels are held on by bolts. Bye, wheels. Hello, sparks.
Stadium seats? Bolted to concrete. The whole crowd slides onto the field.
The Eiffel Tower. Two and a half million rivets. It starts to lean. Pisa is jealous.
Your laptop. Tiny screws. It opens like a sandwich.
Roller coaster. Bolted track. You're upside down. And the track is leaving.
Bolts are back. Everything slams together. The coaster catches you. Screaming. But alive.
Good news. Your furniture rebuilt itself. No leftover screws. First time in human history.
What should vanish next? Comment it, or I pick something worse.
